title: AudioLib schema 8→9 migration report
description: Last stdout line of `audiolib-migrate <action> --db <path>` (exit 0 = ok, otherwise read error_code; second start while running exits 2 with already_running) and the JSON body of GET /admin/api/migration/status and POST /admin/api/migration/{start,pause,resume,cancel,rollback} (409 with the same body for already_running). HTTP-level rules: doc/schemas/migration-http.schema.json.

error_code.description: null on success. disk_full: state paused, checkpoint kept, resume continues. read_only: blocked at preflight, state failed, no backup, DB untouched. io_error: other IO errors.

phases.description: Phase name → elapsed ms. backup, path_build, optimize, switch are always present.

switch.description: source_search_rev is 2 before the switch and 3 after.

ids.description: Search actions only (main_search/path_search --q --limit --cursor): {ids, next_cursor}. This projection omits SearchPage.total_count. Directory searches use limit + 1 lookahead; their total_count is an observed prefix lower bound without a cursor, or a page-local suffix count after a cursor, never a guaranteed global total while more results remain. See doc/api/README.md section 5.

next_cursor.description: Authoritative directory-search continuation: nonempty when lookahead found another hit, null when there are no more pages. The migration search projection uses null; the HTTP SearchPage omits this field on its last page. Internal has_more is not an additional response field.
